text: Super Group (SGHC) Limited, Betway's NYSE-listed parent, has two shareholders above 5% per its FY2025 Form 20-F: Knutsson Limited (45%, beneficially owned via a professional trustee for the Alea Trust) and Chivers Limited (19%). No state or sovereign-fund shareholder is disclosed.
